page_title: ELC 2-2 SEV | Elche v Sevilla 19/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Ricardo De Burgos has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Booking. Bambo Diaby (Elche) receives a caution from the referee.
90+3' Elche failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Inaki Pena gets a hand on the penalty from Akor Adams (Sevilla), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
90+2' Akor Adams (Sevilla) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+1' Handball! A player from Elche handled the ball. PENALTY to Sevilla! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The corner kick from Oso (Sevilla) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
88' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul.
87' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Federico Redondo Solari (Elche) replacing Aleix Febas.
86' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
86' Miguel Sierra (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and German Valera departs the field of play to be replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
80' Yago Santiago (Elche) earns the yellow card.

79' Akor Adams (Sevilla) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Inaki Pena pulls off an easy save.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Elche.
75' 2 - 1 Goal! Akor Adams (Sevilla) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
74' David Affengruber (Elche) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
74' The attendance is 22594.
72' What an opportunity! Miguel Sierra (Sevilla) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
71' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

70' Aleix Febas (Elche) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Elche will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Bambo Diaby (Elche) is brought on as a substitute for Josan.
68' The substitution has been made. Yago Santiago (Elche) has replaced Grady Diangana.
67' Substitution. Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) on for Martim Neto.
67' Matias Almeyda has decided to make a change. Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) replaces Tanguy Nianzou.
63' Matias Almeyda decides to make a substitution. Isaac Romero will be replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
63' Substitution. Djibril Sow makes way for Miguel Sierra (Sevilla).

63' Inaki Pena pulls off a great save to deny Isaac Romero (Sevilla), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
63' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Grady Diangana (Elche) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
61' OFF THE WOODWORK! The resulting free kick finds Oso (Sevilla) who smashes the ball against the left post.
60' It looks like Leo Petrot (Elche) saw red with that tackle. Ricardo De Burgos won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Batista Mendy (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' 2 - 0 German Valera (Elche) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
55' The resulting corner from Josan (Elche) is cleared.
54' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

54' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Elche. A pass into the box finds German Valera (Elche) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Odysseas Vlachodimos denies him.
51' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
50' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
48' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Isaac Romero (Sevilla). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
47' Akor Adams (Sevilla) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) comes off for Tanguy Nianzou.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Matias Almeyda gives a chance to Akor Adams and Peque (Sevilla) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle. Oso (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play.
43' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
43' Oso (Sevilla) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

42' Inaki Pena pulls off a great save to deny Djibril Sow (Sevilla) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
42' The resulting corner from Aleix Febas (Elche) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
41' A quickly taken corner by Elche.

40' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the top left corner. Odysseas Vlachodimos is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball is out of play. Elche will have a chance to score from a corner.
40' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
38' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) tries his luck with a long-range shot, but the ball crashes against the bar. Great effort!
38' Peque (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' Josan (Elche) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
36' Oso (Sevilla) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
35' Grady Diangana (Elche) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
34' A pass from Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is intercepted by Inaki Pena and the move breaks down.
33' Victor Chust (Elche) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
32' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Inaki Pena, who smothers the ball.
30' Martim Neto (Elche) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Elche comes to nothing.

29' Martim Neto (Elche) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Elche force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
28' A crossfield pass from Kike Salas (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates.
25' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
25' Elche take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
21' Victor Chust (Elche) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo De Burgos had an easy-decision to make.
20' Aleix Febas (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but Odysseas Vlachodimos comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' The resulting set piece from Elche is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
18' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
16' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
14' 1 - 0 Aleix Febas (Elche) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
11' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul.
7' Oso (Sevilla) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
4' Inaki Pena (Elche) sends a long ball forward to Alvaro Rodriguez, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
2' Marc Aguado (Elche) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
